text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's heeeere!! The second Summer Training 
Camp! No making doujinshi this year—it's 
all about training, training, training!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
According to King-san's 【Breaking News】, 
my absolute favorite junior Uma Musume is 
actually running in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)... So hype!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to pass on the spirit King 
taught me to that girl... Could this be... 
the birth of Big Sister Digi-tan!? I've 
gotta give it my all for the autumn!
